notes.title: Release V1.2.9
notes.notes: Fixed security issue on load of VBOX Sim

notes.title: Release V1.2.5
notes.notes:
New Features

F1 23 and F1 24 support
KartKraft support added


Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where the VBOX LapTimer did not recognise the start/finish line in some circumstances

notes.title: Release V1.1.25
notes.notes:
New Features

F1 2022 support.
Manual game selection: In the help tab "Game Select" dropdown has been added which will force VBOX Sim to only look for that game.
Custom telemetry port for Codemasters games: If a game from the F1 series is selected with manual game selection an option to change the UDP port used to communicate will be shown as a means of providing compatibility with other applications interacting with them.


Bug Fixes

Fixed a couple of issues relating to data received from Assetto Corsa Competizione.
Fixed a couple of issues where the detected game would repeatedly switch causing logging to stop.
Fixed a couple of issues around the handling of the iRacing data stream which could cause errors in logged data.
Fixed several issues which could prevent a successful ibt vbo merge resulting in lower accuracy vbo data.
Fixed several issues around communication with the VBOX LapTimer which could result in it not detecting a change in games, not receiving updates, or VBOX Sim logging stopping.
Various stability improvements.

notes.title: Release 1.0.63
notes.notes:
We have released VBOX Sim 1.0.63, including the following:

RaceRoom is now supported.
F1 2021 is now supported.
OBS video capture option is now live. On some machine/display configurations this will provide a significant performance boost and added flexibility for video capture area, hardware acceleration options and more.
iRacing integration bug fixes.

We're keen to help: if you encounter issues then as ever, please contact us via email: simsupport@racelogic.co.uk and we will get you back up and running.

notes.title: Release v1.0.29 now available
notes.notes:
F1 2020 support has been added. Please ensure that UDP format is set to "2020" in game settings.

A new 'Game Select' feature has been added on the 'Help' tab. This is only for use in rare situations where VBOX Sim is receiving game data from 2 games simultaneously - usually when the previously used game didn't close properly - causing empty vbo and video files to be created as VBOX Sim switches between games. Unless you encounter problems like this no need to change this from the default  setting.

We are still working on iRacing - we hope to release a version with full iRacing support before the end of the year.

If you do encounter issues we are keen to help - please get in touch at simsupport@racelogic.co.uk with a description of the issue.
